[4:56PM] #Apapa_Ajegunle #TrafficUpdate 

Motorists can expect a fast-moving commute from both Ojo Road and Otto Wharf to Ajeromi. At Ajeromi Junction, all commercial buses are currently being diverted to Ojora Way to connect to Boundary Bus Stop.

Movement from Baale Street to the Boundary Roundabout is also progressing well. Furthermore, the stretch of Mobil Road, both inward and outward, is experiencing fast-moving vehicle traffic at this time.

From High Bridge/Ijora Oloopa Ramp to Total, traffic is flowing quickly on both lanes. However, shortly after Total by the RRS Junction, one lane is occupied by trucks, while the second lane remains clear for cars and other vehicles.

Lastly, vehicles exiting Apapa Front Point Road through the Marine Bridge to Iganmu are also encountering fast-moving traffic. No impediments have been recorded as of this hour, and officers are on ground ensuring smooth traffic flow.

#FollowLASTMA

Busy traffic conditions on the stretch from Tinubu Square to Nnamdi Azikiwe Street, en route to Tom Jones Intersection, largely due to market activities.
Slow movement under the Idumota Bridge, particularly on the inward journey from Eyin Eyo to Balogun and Martin Streets, resulting from bus stop activities along the corridor.
Smooth traffic flow on Ilubinrin connecting Carter Bridge, inward towards Ijora Olopa, as well as Oyingbo, with vehicles moving at a relatively faster pace.

Officers remain actively engaged in managing the traffic flow to mitigate congestion.
